Description
With PAMP Suisse’s reputation for beautiful bar designs, this .999 fine 10 gram Silver bar exemplifies beauty through the depiction of classic religious symbols. Here, the Romanesque Cross is commemorated as a symbol for the Christian religion. Product Highlights: Contains 10 grams of .999 fine Silver. Every Silver bar comes in an assay card verifying a certified assayer has approved the bar. Obverse: Features a depiction of the Roman Cross on a pedestal with radiant beams of light portrayed in the background. Reverse: Displays the PAMP Suisse logo, weight and purity along with a unique serial number. Contained on the assay card is a serial number matching the one on each bar, and guarantees the weight and purity of these PAMP Silver Bars. The cross has been symbol of love, hope, and the forgiveness of sins since the crucifixion of Jesus Christ according to the Christian faith making this a great gift item for loved ones or as an addition to your personal investment collection. Add the 10 gram Silver PAMP Romanesque Cross Bar to your cart today!
